name: duration-formatter-naming
goal: Helpers use names that explain their transformation; formatDuration replaces audioDuration without changing time formatting

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The existing numeric formatter is pure and reused by three components, but its audioDuration name obscures formatting. The old name predates the recent helper review; that review checked eligibility without assessing naming. Before screenshot: /tmp/harness-duration-naming-before.png

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing packages/reports/test/utils/evidence-media.test.ts covered media types and two formatted results but no export naming or invalid values. Strengthened the same test to require formatDuration and retain output/invalid-input behavior; this is the normal Vitest suite guard.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit 213ae47f; record 57b47d4b9070c4b0df2ba5de68e725377605e28ab37ddf32a574a8093b887f6c fails with duration formatting is named for its operation: formatDuration is missing. The existing search test passes.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Rename only the numeric formatter and its three callers; retain stable unit identity and outputs. Add semantic naming review to project and installed Harness skills, independent of purity/reuse. The strengthened existing media test guards the public export; manually assess naming against contrasting transformation, effectful and single-consumer cases.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Renamed the source export, AudioEvidence, AudioComparison and ReplayControls; updated the stable unit contract with a 90-second sample and string output. Added separate semantic Helper Naming Review to root project and installed harness-project skills, with the reports package linking to the root rule. No eligibility changes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged test and exact command/environment passed at 741c2b5e; green record a6ba47aadd3e4cca78f278d258166b01d303d89799e9d764f229ccd4ebffbf79 references frozen red 213ae47f.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated git archive of 741c2b5e: restoring audioDuration in export and all three callers makes the same unchanged test fail with duration formatting is named for its operation (exit 1). Restoring exact fixed source passes (exit 0). Logs /tmp/harness-duration-guard-{reintroduced,restored}.log. Skill validator passes; semantic review rejects audioDuration for seconds-to-text, accepts formatDuration for three consumers, keeps a one-consumer formatter private, and treats file reads as effectful.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
